data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of you to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At k=25, next stock is 500 or 100, so recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run income may suffer. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each fisher: what exact catch do you intend, and is it conditional?
